mapper.select: select a.robot_id robotId, a.robot_code robotCode, a.robot_name robotName, a.robot_status robotStatus, a.last_online_time lastOnlineTime, a.off_line_count offLineCount, a.duration from t_robot_info a where 1 = 1 and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_code = #{robotCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, tr.robot_code robotCode, tr.commission_date commissionDate, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) + 1 runDay, COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) taskDay, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) - COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ta.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) + 1 normalDay FROM t_robot_info tr LEFT JOIN t_robot_alarm ta ON ta.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` AND ( ta.alarm_time IS NULL OR ta.alarm_time >= tr.commission_date ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tc ON tc.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result tcr ON tcr.`task_id` = tc.`task_id` AND tcr.execute_time <=NOW() WHERE tr.commission_date IS TRUE AND tr.commission_date <= NOW() and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

SELECT robot_id, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) + 1 totalNum, (SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.cruise_task_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) FROM t_cruise_task_result tcr LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tct ON tcr.task_id = tct.task_id AND tcr.task_status!=238 and tcr.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} WHERE tct.robot_id = tr.`robot_id`) AS validNum FROM t_robot_info tr WHERE tr.`commission_date` IS TRUE AND tr.`commission_date` <= NOW() AND robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, count(t.deal_type) as validNum FROM (select deal_type,warn_time from t_warn_info union all( select deal_type,defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286,1,0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type,warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all( select deal_type,defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}

SELECT count( 1 ) AS totalNum, sum( IF ( tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0 ) ) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result tcdr ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and result.task_id = #{taskId}

SELECT count( 1 ) AS totalNum, count( result.identify_result ) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime}
